valueType.description:
The value type of the restriction. Note that anyof restrictions can only be definite types (not `any` nor a
nested `anyof`).

exclude.description:
True if this type is _excluded_ in an {@link AnyOfType anyof}. Exclude restrictions are introduced with the
circumflex character (`^`) and indicate that the specified value type is excluded from the types in the other
restrictions.

title:
The anyof restrictions is just a basic value type (not any/anyof) plus a flag indicating whether the restriction is
an exclude rather than an alternate.

For example, this declaration:
```type
message: string | [string]
```
Indicates that the message field may contain either a single string or an array of strings.

It is also possible to refine an anyof by excluding some subset of the other types. For example:
```type
seriousActs: [CircusAct ^ ClownAct]
```
In this example, seriousActs is an array of CircusActs, but _not_ ClownActs (assuming ClownAct mixes CircusAct).

Another example is the way the #valueType field is defined. The restrictions of any anyof may not be a (nested)
anyof or an `any` type; they may only only be concrete types.
name: AnyOfRestriction
